no.p: Pero an ambulance is an emergency medical service, not standard fare-paying public transit.
Pero a boat travels on water, not by road.
Pero a motorbike is private transport, not a collective public transit vehicle.
Pero a plane travels by air, not by road.
Pero a truck is used for freight or cargo, not public passenger transport.
Pero a train runs on rails, not by road.
